toyama.name: Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route
toyama.nameJP: 立山黒部アルペンルート
toyama.desc: Japan's greatest mountain sightseeing route crossing the northern Alps at 2,450m. Snow walls up to 20m in spring.

toyama.name: Gokayama
toyama.desc: UNESCO World Heritage gassho-zukuri farmhouses hidden in mountain valleys. Smaller and quieter than Shirakawa-go.

toyama.name: Toyama Castle
toyama.desc: Reconstructed Edo-period castle surrounded by a moat. Now houses a city history museum in its grounds.

toyama.name: Kurobe Dam
toyama.desc: Japan's largest arch dam at 186m tall. Dramatic water discharge in summer; reached via the Alpine Route.

toyama.name: Zuiryuji Temple
toyama.desc: National Treasure Zen temple built in the 17th century. One of the finest Edo-period temple complexes in Japan.

toyama.name: Toyama Glass Art Museum
toyama.desc: Stunning contemporary art museum designed by Kengo Kuma, specializing in glass artworks from Japan and abroad.

toyama.name: Unazuki Onsen
toyama.desc: Scenic hot spring town at the gateway to Kurobe Gorge. Famous for clear river waters and steam-filled baths.

toyama.name: Himi City
toyama.desc: Coastal fishing town famous for Himi yellowtail (buri) in winter, fresh seafood markets, and views across Toyama Bay.

toyama.name: Tonami Scattered Village
toyama.desc: Unique landscape where farmhouses are scattered across the Tonami Plain, each surrounded by windbreak trees. Best from the Sankyoson Viewpoint.

toyama.name: Kurobe Gorge Railway
toyama.desc: Open-air trolley train ride through Japan's deepest gorge, past hot springs and dense forest. Operates spring to autumn.

japan.name: Fushimi Inari Taisha
japan.desc: Thousands of vermilion torii gates winding up a forested mountain. One of Japan's most iconic spiritual sites.

japan.name: Nara Park & Todaiji
japan.desc: Roam freely with hundreds of sacred deer while exploring Japan's largest bronze Buddha statue.

japan.name: Dotonbori
japan.desc: Osaka's neon-lit entertainment district along the canal, famous for street food and the giant Glico running man sign.

japan.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
japan.desc: Towering bamboo stalks lining a narrow path in western Kyoto, near Tenryuji temple and Togetsukyo Bridge.

japan.name: Sensoji Temple
japan.desc: Tokyo's oldest temple in Asakusa. The approach lined with Nakamise shopping street is a feast for the senses.

japan.name: Mount Fuji
japan.desc: Japan's highest peak and most iconic image. Climb in summer or view from Kawaguchiko for postcard-perfect reflections.

japan.name: Hiroshima Peace Memorial
japan.desc: A moving memorial park with the Atomic Bomb Dome, Peace Museum, and Thousand Paper Cranes — a profound place of reflection.

japan.name: Shirakawa-go
japan.desc: UNESCO-listed historic village with gassho-zukuri thatched farmhouses. Magical in winter snow; easily reached from Toyama.

japan.name: Hakone
japan.desc: Hot spring resort town with stunning Mt. Fuji views, the Open Air Museum, lake cruises, and mountain railways.

japan.name: Kenroku-en, Kanazawa
japan.desc: One of Japan's Three Great Gardens surrounding Kanazawa Castle. Just 1 hour from Toyama by Shinkansen.

world.name: Hoi An Ancient Town
world.desc: UNESCO World Heritage trading port with lantern-lit streets, tailors, and blended Vietnamese-Chinese-Japanese architecture.

world.name: Hanoi Old Quarter
world.desc: Vietnam's capital with a maze of streets named after their historic trades, street food, and Hoan Kiem Lake.

world.name: Ha Long Bay
world.desc: UNESCO World Heritage bay with thousands of limestone karsts and islands rising from emerald-green waters.

world.name: Chiang Mai Old City
world.desc: Northern Thailand's cultural capital surrounded by a moat, filled with ancient temples, night markets, and mountain treks.

world.name: Jiufen
world.desc: Hillside gold-mining town with narrow stone stairways and red lanterns overlooking the Pacific — said to have inspired Spirited Away.

world.name: Gyeongju
world.desc: The ancient Silla capital, known as a museum without walls — royal tombs, Bulguksa Temple, and the Cheomseongdae observatory.

world.name: Gardens by the Bay
world.nameJP: ガーデンズバイザベイ
world.desc: Futuristic nature park featuring towering Supertrees, the Cloud Forest dome, and spectacular light shows at night.

world.name: Northern Lights, Iceland
world.nameJP: オーロラ・アイスランド
world.desc: The ultimate aurora borealis experience — vast volcanic landscapes, geysers, and curtains of green and purple light across the night sky.
